campaign.permittedWork: PDP-3 source review, denominator reconciliation, contract/source mapping, and prescribed MDC-30 checks only

sourcePinReview.fingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 of JSON.stringify over sorted [repository-relative path, current file sha256] pairs for the 337 paths in the historical PDP-3 sourceShaSet

changedSources.classification: Artifact identity index adds governance records and an observation-only PDP-3 runtime-dispositions record; metadata only.

Authority/status text now says DEV_COMPLETE at its recorded cut for the same population, while preserving independent acceptance and runtime admission as separate. No journey semantic change found; status statement remains historical-cut bound.

Regenerated dependency/index projections and external source observations; no direct journey or screen definition change found. Current live sibling states differ from several external snapshots, so external owner currentness is not claimed.
Projection adds governance and observation-only artifact index entries; no definition change.
Implementation-only: exact subject references, action finality messaging, and in-flight duplicate prevention; no PDP-3 definition source changed.

definitionPopulation.conditionalRetryScenario: media.scenario.job-retry-eligible is explicitly conditional/non-executable and is not Explorer-indexed.

findings.phaseOwner: media-experience owner with the accountable consumer/channel owners
findings.summary: The current sources do not provide complete, source-supported per-journey channel bindings across all 30 journeys.

evidence.commonDeclaration: PDP-0 proposed channels only; per-channel operation, state, transport, and accessibility equivalence remain unbound.
evidence.limitation: These authorities leave HTTP route identity, gRPC wire/version crosswalk, SDK parity, CLI production mapping, and per-journey channel equivalence unresolved. Completing those links now would require invented semantics, routes, runtime admission, or owner approval.
evidence.definitionClassification: PDP-3 definition/source-linkage gap for MDC-30; not a Build or runtime-admission substitute.

findings.acceptance: Each applicable journey/channel relation is explicitly bound to source-supported operation, state, transport, version, accessibility, negative/finality, and recovery semantics; unresolved relations retain exact authority and owner without implying admission.

findings.summary: The integrations consumer PDP-3 applicability is unresolved and cannot be counted as applicable or N/A.

evidence.rationale: Each external handoff requires its own owner-approved contract and availability evidence.
evidence.disposition: UNKNOWN_OWNER_DECISION_PENDING; retain in the 17-consumer denominator; do not mark applicable or N/A.

findings.acceptance: An authoritative, explicit PDP-3 applicability decision and rationale reconciles the registry with the service/journey references; no runtime/availability acceptance is implied.

findings.phaseOwner: media-experience owner with PDP-1 domain owners
findings.summary: The bounded step-level review is complete and precisely classifies passive, read-only, external, and consequential cases; the 14 consequential command/workflow bindings still lack accepted exact state-transition mappings, so current PDP-3 completion remains blocked.

evidence.reviewBoundary: The exact 54 transition rows and 118 null purpose dispositions were classified. This closes the classification review only; it does not close owner mapping, acceptance, route/transport, or state-transition definition tasks.

sourceOnlyDispositionGuidance.consequential: EFFECT_DEFINED; TRANSITION_UNBOUND_OR_UNKNOWN until exact owner mapping is accepted

purposeBindingClassification.acceptedMappingStatus: NOT_ESTABLISHED: state-transition-bindings.yaml is selected-lane proposal; P0-010 acceptance remains pending
purposeBindingClassification.reviewIntegrity: Source-only classification; no owner acceptance, independent signoff, route, runtime admission, or accepted state mapping is claimed.

findings.acceptance: Every consequential stateful step has an exact applicable P0/P1 state/transition and action/operation binding accepted by its accountable owner, or a source-backed explicit no-domain-state rationale; all other transition rows carry precise pending/unbound source-only dispositions. No proposal is promoted to accepted mapping.

findings.phaseOwner: external repository owners; Media source-manifest owner
findings.summary: The local source-manifest externalOwnerObservations do not match current sibling checkout revisions/worktree state.

evidence.interpretation: The source-manifest labels these as SOURCE_OBSERVATION_ONLY; they do not establish current owner acceptance. No external checkout was modified.

requiredChecks.note: Prescribed MDC-30 source-definition suite; passing checks do not clear channel-binding or applicability findings and are not a PDP-3 exit.
